purpose: Evaluate atom-level xTB density descriptors for electrophilic aromatic substitution regioselectivity.

selection.input: public reaction records with atom mapping and a single EAS electrophilic aromatic substitution event
selection.event_field: event_type or reaction_class when present; records without an event field must be prefiltered by the source adapter
exclude: mixtures without a mapped reacting molecule
selection.deduplicate: canonical mapped reactant scaffold and reaction identifier
selection.label_indexing: zero-based RDKit atom indices after SMILES sanitization

geometry.seed_derivation: SHA256(seed:record_id) first 8 hex digits modulo 2147483646 plus 1
geometry.failed_conformers: record and exclude from feature aggregation; never impute

calculation.comparison_geometry: identical optimized coordinates for GFN1 and GFN2 single points
calculation.spin: RDKit-derived multiplicity; explicit for open-shell records
calculation.engine_call_semantics: zero additional calls after each retained single-point result; density descriptors consume C, S and AO maps from that result
calculation.gfn0_scope: single-point descriptors only; no Delta-SCF or shell-charge equivalence

split.primary: Bemis-Murcko scaffold split with Morgan-cluster leakage constraint
split.leakage_rule: all records sharing a scaffold or cluster stay in one partition or fold

outputs.descriptor_source: retained single-point XTBResult; no extra engine call for density extraction
required_feature_families: Mulliken/Loewdin density populations and p-to-s ratios
pi population and pi bond order
fixed-geometry Fukui and local conceptual-DFT descriptors
outputs.missing_value_policy: preserve null and reason; never impute during feature generation
outputs.report_format: nested JSON feature reports with atom and bond indices fixed to RDKit input order
